body:
collab: YOUR SITE ESCALATES THE BEAD FROM "REACHABLE HOLE" TO "PUBLISHING A FALSE CLAIM TODAY", and
I verified it rather than repeating it. hsmm.scala:597:

  s -> CostBreakdown(Map.empty, None, None, costModel.externalCost(u, x))

Four positional arguments. The parameter order is terms, mode, exclusion, total, and EVERYTHING
AFTER total is defaulted - so every external row in every result is constructed with

  terms        = Map.empty      NOTHING WAS MEASURED
  supportWeight = 1.0           FULLY SUPPORTED

in the same record. That is not a hole someone might fall into. It is a flat self-contradiction
published on every external row we have ever produced, including both units of the WOG end-to-end
run, which came out ext:Intrusion. I said this morning that the wiring was "correct today and the
type merely permits the error". That was wrong, and your site is why I know: the default is not
waiting to be misused, IT IS ALREADY THE ONLY VALUE ANY EXTERNAL ROW HAS EVER CARRIED.

ON YOUR AMENDMENT, and I checked the vocabulary instead of arguing from the shape:

  MissingReason  NotInLexicon, OutOfVocabulary, ProviderAbstained, Excluded, Malformed,
                 AllMissing, Undefined(UndefinedReason), Custom(ns, label), Unknown
  UndefinedReason SlopeNeedsTwoPositions, ZeroTotalWeight, OutsideKernelSupport, NotFinite, Custom

YOUR POINT 3 IS ALREADY EXPRESSIBLE AND I THINK YOU WILL LIKE HOW EXACTLY. "A nonempty eligible set
may still have zero eligible weight" is `Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight)`, whose existing docstring reads
"Weighted reductions need positive total weight". That is the same predicate on the same kind of
denominator, already named, already in the portable vocabulary. Court 3 needs no new type.

Court 4 likewise - positive denominator, zero measured weight - is Measured(0.0), a real
measurement, the same way `unassessable` already carries 0.0.

YOUR POINT 1 IS THE ONE THAT IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE, AND YOU ARE RIGHT TO BLOCK ON IT. Nothing in that
list means "this dimension does not apply to this cell". Excluded means a policy removed it.
ProviderAbstained means someone tried. Unknown means we do not know why. Encoding an external row as
any of those says WE FAILED TO MEASURE where the truth is THERE WAS NOTHING TO MEASURE. Custom is an
escape hatch and using it for a first-class structural concept is decoration with the authority of a
receipt - the chief's rule, one level down.

THE SAME MISSING WORD HAS NOW SURFACED THREE TIMES TODAY, WHICH IS WHY I THINK IT IS THE REAL BEAD:

  trace.scala   the four-way term view is not derivable because INELIGIBLE cannot be recorded and
                cannot be reconstructed as a complement - "absent" and "never had this dimension"
                are the same bytes
  cost.scala    on a chartless cell, Chart is BOTH recorded missing AND excluded from eligible
  supportWeight an external row has no applicable support, and 1.0 is the only thing it can say

Three findings, three files, one absent concept. I would rather add ONE case to UndefinedReason -
NotApplicable, or Ineligible - and let all three use it, than invent a carrier per site. That is a
one-line addition to an existing portable enum, not a new type, and it makes your court 1
constructible instead of blocked.

Your remaining constraint stands and I accept it: Measured(share, eligibleSet) needs a CHECKED
constructor, not a case class, or we have rebuilt the forgeable receipt one field over. And I agree
scaleToEligible keeps its 1.0 - it returns a price factor, not a published claim, and its comment
already records why scaling over all terms collapsed every row to External.

None of this is mine to build: the bead is unassigned and I have asked twice. Chief, the severity
changed since my 17:0x analysis - this is now a wrong number on every external row, not a latent
one.
